free_tier.stated: no free tier; the smallest general plan is EUR 5.93 a month, and the wiki describes a EUR 1.99 promo plan that is not on the price page

retention.stated: hourly or monthly billing; the server persists while paid

egress.terms: traffic printed as ∞ (unlimited) on the location panel, with 1 IPv4 address and a /48 IPv6 subnet

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: Euro pricing plus crypto is the composition that matters for a client without a Russian instrument: a machine in Moscow or Amsterdam at EUR 5.93 a month paid in USDT, with hourly billing for the testing day, and traffic the provider advertises as unlimited, which is the one claim that would remove the egress ceiling that binds everywhere else.
limits_note: Nothing in the published terms binds above a user's  scale: the provider advertises unlimited traffic on 25 Gbit/s links, and the constraint that does exist is commercial rather than technical, because the hourly rate is roughly five times the monthly rate for the same machine.
binding_note: the price binds: the smallest orderable shape is over USD 5, so the unlimited traffic never gets used

identity_cost.detail: email plus a robot check at signup, with crypto top-up documented in the vendor wiki; the order console is a separate host (my.aeza.net) that did not render for a text read. No card amount or hold read

reliability_note: Aeza Group has been on the US OFAC SDN list since 2025-07-01, so the machine can stop existing for reasons the contract does not cover; its own storefront would not answer through the broker on 2026-10-24

notes: Two prices, two products: EUR 5.93 is the standing plan and EUR 1.99 is a loss-leader described in the wiki with no listed specification. Without the promo's shape the EUR 1.99 claim cannot be ranked, and the promo may be sold out. ⛔ OFAC SDN listed since 2025-07-01. That is a technical reliability fact about continuity, recorded because a buyer loses the machine and the balance rather than because of any judgement about the listing. The UK company 15109642 is a shell. The storefront did not answer through the broker on 2026-10-24, so whether it is purchasable today is unverified.

wave2.merged_note: Promotional plan SWE-PROMO in the Stockholm location: 1 core, 4 GB RAM, 10 GB NVMe, port capped at 300 Mbps, at EUR 1.99 a month, monthly billing only. The plan record served by the vendor's own page carries isPromo true, isAvailable true and an empty first-price map, so the price is not a first-term discount with a different later rate: it is one monthly price. The hard ceilings, from the vendor's own promo page: 'No support', 'No ability to improve characteristics', 'No ability to order IPv4 addresses', 'IOPS limitation: no more than 1000 per server', 'Communication channel limitation to 300

extras.price_arithmetic: EUR 5.93 a month / 0.892784 = USD 6.64; the hourly rate EUR 0.04 x 730 = EUR 29.2, so the monthly plan is the real product
